title: Automatic pricing
hint: The price follows your province's market, demand and supply within your range.
current: Current price: {price} UZS/{unit}. It must be inside the range.
warning: The price moves at most {step}% a day and stays within your range. It never goes above the market's upper quartile (P75). The bot tells you about each change, and you can undo it.
offNote: Off: the price changes only when you change it.
paused: Paused until {time}. The price was set by hand or undone, so the system leaves it alone for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.

history.title: Price history
history.hint: Automatic changes, newest first. You can undo the latest one.
history.median: Province median {price} UZS ({count, plural, one {# price} other {# prices}})
history.reverted: The previous price is back. Automatic pricing pauses for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
history.contribHint: Each reason's exact share (Shapley values): the parts add up to the total change.
